game.name: International Cricket 2010 (Europe)
game.desc: International Cricket 2010 is a sports game for Xbox 360 based on cricket. A sport that is little known in France but very popular in the UK. For the occasion, Codemasters has brought together the majority of the most influential leagues' licences. You control a cricket team, with a 360° camera that allows you to direct the game and its tactical choices. A multiplayer mode is also included.
